note: Source-precedence tier 1 targets: the 11 manufacturers behind the 139 matched active sauna SKUs. Build Brief v2 said '~15 manufacturers'; the catalogue says 11. Reported rather than rounded to the brief.
why_every_product_url_template_is_null: These were written from a session with NO network access to any manufacturer host (403 on CONNECT, organisation egress policy). A URL template that cannot be tested is a guess.

A guessed template does not fail safely. inh-seo/CLAUDE.md records two instances of exactly this: a followed redirect answered from /collections/best-infrared-saunas while the requested URL was a product page, putting a category page's FAQ into a report as a product specification. The fetch succeeded and the content was real; the ATTRIBUTION was wrong.

So the fetcher SKIPS any vendor whose template is null and records NEEDS_URL_TEMPLATE. Run `fetch-manufacturer-specs.yml` with mode=discover first: it probes robots.txt and the homepage for each vendor from Actions, where the network works, and reports what is actually reachable. Fill these in from that evidence, not from memory.

`base` domains below are the vendors' commonly-published sites and are themselves UNVERIFIED from this session. The discover run checks them; treat a failure there as 'the domain is wrong', not 'the vendor has no site'.

Dynamic Saunas.notes: Largest single vendor. Models are SKU-coded (DYN-6103-01); the spec page is likely keyed on that rather than on our handle.

Maxxus.notes: MX-K306-01 style SKUs. Shares a distributor with Golden Designs; the two may resolve to one site.

Golden Designs Inc.notes: GDI-coded SKUs. Publishes stove kW on traditional/hybrid models, which is the highest-value gap in the dataset.

Scandia.notes: Cabins and heaters are separate lines; a cabin page may not state a kW at all because the heater is sold separately.

Dundalk Leisurecraft.notes: Heater-ready cabins. Expect 'recommended 8 kW heater' rather than a fitted rating -- a recommendation is not the unit's rating and must not be read as one.

Medical Saunas.notes: No SKU on several variants; resolution may have to go via title.

Finnmark Designs.notes: FD-1..FD-5. Already the best-documented vendor in our own metafields; useful as a CONTROL -- if the fetcher disagrees with the metafield here, suspect the fetcher.

Kohler.notes: Large site with a strict robots.txt in all likelihood; expect ROBOTS_DISALLOWED and accept it.
